newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Amic calls for interest rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Amic calls for interest rate cut.

text.p: Anglo American Industrial Corp Ltd (Amic) said on Wednesday that an improvement in global commodity prices and an increase in export activity would have a favourable impact on its earnings for the full year.
But the firm warned that a cut in the country's interest rates was needed to boost economic activity or the firm's earnings could come under threat.

"There is a risk that monetary policy will be kept too stringent for too long. Such a development could jeopardise Amic's target of achieving a real increase in earnings for the year," Amic chairman Leslie Boyd said in a statement with the group's half year results.
"There is a growing concern that the economy will weaken further unless action is taken soon," Boyd said.

Boyd said a short-term interest rate cut was now appropriate as South Africa was experiencing a substantially improved balance of payments, including greatly increased gold and foreign exchange reserves.
Earlier Amic posted a half year headline earnings per share up to 658 cents from 608 cents.
